recognize_zh: 四張皮膚照片：A 圖肢體密集紅色斑丘疹（麻疹樣）；B 圖深色皮膚上紫灰色、邊緣隆起的扁平苔蘚樣斑塊；C 圖小腿散在紅色鱗屑性丘疹；D 圖紅斑背景上密集毛囊性小丘疹（毛囊角化樣）。這些都屬於 NIH 慢性移植物抗宿主病皮膚評分中的「紅斑（erythema）」類別。
features: A: dense erythematous maculopapular (morbilliform) eruption on the extremity
B: violaceous, polygonal lichen planus-like plaques with a raised border on darkly pigmented skin
C: scattered erythematous scaly papules and small plaques on the lower leg (papulosquamous)
D: diffuse erythema with numerous monomorphic follicular papules (keratosis pilaris-like)
describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of cutaneous lesions grouped under the NIH erythema category for chronic graft-versus-host disease scoring. Panel A shows a confluent erythematous maculopapular, morbilliform eruption. Panel B shows violaceous polygonal lichen planus-like plaques with raised borders on pigmented skin. Panel C shows scattered erythematous papulosquamous papules on the lower leg, and panel D shows diffuse erythema with keratosis pilaris-like follicular papules. Of these, lichen planus-like lesions are diagnostic of chronic GVHD, while maculopapular erythema and papulosquamous or follicular lesions are shared with acute GVHD or other conditions and need other supporting features.

ddx.vs: Drug exanthems begin within days to weeks of a new medication and resolve after withdrawal, whereas GVHD rashes track with immunosuppression changes and show interface dermatitis with satellite necrosis.
Viral rashes occur with fever and positive viral PCR and lack lichenoid or sclerotic features.
Morphology is identical, so distinction rests on post-transplant context and other cGVHD organ involvement.
Psoriasis has thick silvery scale on extensor surfaces and pityriasis rosea shows a herald patch with collarette scale, unlike the GVHD papulosquamous pattern.

captions: C: Papulosquamous erythematous papules on leg
D: Keratosis pilaris-like follicular papules on erythematous skin
